intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: Senna is reading a letter sealed with green wax. She holds it at arm’s length, like a mushroom she doesn’t trust.

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “My mother. ‘Have you attended a ball? Are you presentable yet?’”

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “She underlined *presentable*. Twice. The nib went through.”

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “I looked it up. ‘Fit to be seen.’ I’m seen all day, mostly by people holding their own ankle.”

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “So what does she mean? Be specific.”

options.labelText: “Write back yes. Send her a sketch of you exactly like this. Apron and all.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She turns the letter over and writes: *Dear Mother. Yes. Sketch enclosed.*

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: Then she pulls the pencil from her bun to start the sketch. The bun comes down. She draws that too.

options.labelText: “A princess with soil on her gloves? Your mother has a point.”

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “Then you two should write to each other.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She files the letter in an apron pocket labeled *IRRITANTS* and leaves.

options.labelText: “Maybe go to just one ball? It might make her happy.”

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “I could stand by the canapés and tell people which garnish to leave on the plate.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She writes *Considering it* on the back of the letter. She doesn’t underline anything.
